eventsAndTrainings.title: UX Research in the Age of AI
eventsAndTrainings.description: Explore how AI tools are reshaping user research workflows — best practices for AI-assisted synthesis and maintaining research integrity at scale.

eventsAndTrainings.title: AI in Product Design: Practical Applications for 2026
eventsAndTrainings.description: Discover how leading product teams are integrating AI — from AI-assisted wireframing to automated accessibility audits and smart component suggestions.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Adobe Connect Community Mixer – Q1 2026
eventsAndTrainings.description: Connect with fellow community members over virtual coffee. A great way to meet people across teams and build lasting professional relationships.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Connect BuildFest 2026 – 48-Hour Design Hackathon
eventsAndTrainings.description: Form a team of 2–4 and build something using Adobe Connect APIs. Prizes for Best UX, Most Innovative Use Case, and Community Favourite.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Design Systems Summit 2026
eventsAndTrainings.description: A full-day summit bringing together designers and engineers to explore scalable design systems, component governance, token strategies, and cross-team collaboration.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Adobe Connect Anniversary Celebration & Networking Night
eventsAndTrainings.description: Celebrate another year of community, creativity, and connection. Join us for an evening of networking, live demos, team shoutouts, and a few surprises.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Future of Remote Collaboration – Panel Discussion
eventsAndTrainings.description: Industry leaders and Adobe Connect power users come together to discuss async workflows, hybrid team dynamics, and what the next generation of remote collaboration looks like.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Figma Deep Dive – Variables & Auto Layout
eventsAndTrainings.description: Structured session for intermediate-to-advanced Figma users. Covers Variables, auto-layout, high-fidelity prototyping, and Dev Mode handoff best practices.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Plain Language & Global Content Writing
eventsAndTrainings.description: Practical training on plain language principles, cultural sensitivity in copy, writing for accessibility, and creating content that resonates globally.

eventsAndTrainings.title: API Security Fundamentals
eventsAndTrainings.description: Deep dive into API authentication, authorization patterns, OAuth 2.0, JWT handling, and practical security auditing techniques for backend developers.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Accessibility & Inclusive Design
eventsAndTrainings.description: Covers WCAG 2.2, ARIA best practices, color contrast, keyboard navigation, screen-reader testing, and building accessible component libraries.

eventsAndTrainings.title: React Performance Optimisation
eventsAndTrainings.description: Profiling, memoization, lazy loading, concurrent rendering, and avoiding common React anti-patterns that slow down large applications.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Data Visualisation with D3.js
eventsAndTrainings.description: Building interactive charts and data-driven documents using the D3.js library. Covers scales, axes, transitions, and real-world dashboard patterns.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Design Thinking & Rapid Prototyping
eventsAndTrainings.description: A hands-on workshop covering the full design thinking process — empathise, define, ideate, prototype, and test — with rapid prototyping exercises using real-world scenarios.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Advanced CSS & Animation Techniques
eventsAndTrainings.description: Deep dive into modern CSS features — container queries, cascade layers, custom properties, and GPU-accelerated animations for building polished, performant UIs.

eventsAndTrainings.title: Product Analytics & Data-Driven Decision Making
eventsAndTrainings.description: Learn how to set up funnels, retention cohorts, and behavioural analytics to make confident product decisions backed by real user data using Adobe Analytics and Mixpanel.
